# Zinc (hcp): EOS reconstruction reports

[All reconstruction reports](index.md) · [Material and EOS parameters](../material-summaries/zinc_hcp.md) · [EOSMAT record file](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/materials/zinc_hcp.eosmat) · [Audit sidecar](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/audits/zinc_hcp.audit.json)

Each section opens with the record's reproduction headline and any usage
warning ([label definitions](../eos-labels.md)), then the scope and basis of
the stored check. Only recorded content is shown: missing selections, weights,
errors or conventions are unknown, not zero, and are not inferred. Generating
this page fits nothing and changes no classification or source coefficient.
Every record is also listed by identifier in the
[numerical ledger](../primary-eos-refits.md#records), its
[machine-readable form](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/docs/data/primary-eos-refits.json) and the
[source-audit reports](../source-audits.md).

**Curves and residuals** replay the full stored source and reconstructed
coefficients on the same recorded audit inputs. Residual = model − input in
the fitted quantity's native units; for pressure, P(model) − P(input) at each
input volume and temperature (isothermal records use their reference
temperature). RMS is an unweighted descriptive error, not a parameter
uncertainty or the weighted fitting objective. With more than five
temperatures, the minimum, middle and maximum isotherms are drawn; residuals
include every selected row. Error bars appear only where all widths are
recoverable and keep the source meaning, including digitization widths.
No uncertainty band is inferred.

**Coefficient graphs** show stored central values and recorded error widths
in the audit's units; each panel includes zero. They are not observation or
residual plots. Fixed/adopted values are constraints, not recovered values.
Tables round an error to two significant digits when its leading digit is 1
or 2, otherwise one, and the value to the error's decimal place; values
without a positive error show at most six significant digits. Full precision
stays in EOSMAT and the ledger.

## Dewaele (2019), Zn MAO-scale Vinet

**reproduced** · `zinc_hcp_dewaele_2019_mao_vinet` · `Vinet` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/zinc_hcp.md#record-zinc_hcp_dewaele_2019_mao_vinet)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Agreement within the source's reported parameter error widths; this is not an inferred confidence convention.

- Every compared free central value lies inside its printed source error width, with finite reconstructed standard errors under the explicit conditional error model. This is numerical parameter parity, not a formal source-confidence test or recovery of author workflow. Equal weights on the original pressure residuals; observed volumes and fixed coefficients conditioned on. Earlier audit statement (superseded only as to missing reconstruction uncertainty and the resulting numerical label): Complete source rows for this material are bundled and the dedicated two-ruby-scale refit recovers every coefficient within the published 95% interval. The common ledger classifies the result as similar, not strict parity, because the dedicated audit does not infer a refit covariance from rounded source rows. See docs/literature-reproductions/uncertainty-reconstruction.md for the complete conditional uncertainty budget.

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** zinc\_dewaele\_2008\_table2\_compression
- **Observations:** 43
- **Fit kind:** static\_vinet\_with\_explicit\_ruby\_scale\_conversion
- **Selection:** complete
- **Objective:** unweighted pressure residuals
- **Weighting:** Equal weights on the original pressure residuals; observed volumes and fixed coefficients conditioned on.
- **Absolute sigma:** False
- **Free parameters:** V0; K0; K0\_prime
- **Fixed parameters:** None declared
